{"Implementation approach":"Alice, Eve, Alex: Bob here. We will preserve protocol files exactly and build a clean, deterministic, headless-friendly Snake core in C++17 using CMake. The runtime entry is thin (src/Main.cpp). We separate pure domain entities (Board, Snake) and orchestration (Game) from the RNG boundary (IRandom/DefaultRandom) to keep tests deterministic and portable. Tests include only headers and seed the RNG. We honor strict compilation contracts: include/Types.h is the sole definition site for Position and Direction; any header that mentions either includes "Types.h" directly. include/IRandom.h declares both IRandom and DefaultRandom; src/Random.cpp includes "IRandom.h" exactly. include/IRandom.h directly includes <cstddef>, <cstdint>, and <random>, using std::size_t and std::uint32_t with a std::mt19937 data member. include/Game.h directly includes "Board.h", "IRandom.h", "Snake.h", "Types.h", <cstddef>, <deque>, and <optional>. Direction reversal is prevented; food placement uses the RNG on unoccupied cells; moving into tail is allowed only if not growing. The Game constructor validates dimensions and uses the exact initializer snake_(Position{static_cast<int>(width / 2), static_cast<int>(height / 2)}, Direction::Right, 3). CMake builds a core library from non-Main sources, links runtime and tests to it, calls enable_testing(), and registers the test. Each target_compile_options flag is a separate argument. No GUI or OS-specific behavior; tests run via ctest.","Domain Decomposition":[["Build configuration and single project definition; core library plus runtime and tests","CMakeLists.txt","protocol-required"],["Runtime bootstrap: thin demo wiring to construct Game, tick a few times, and print","src/Main.cpp","environment-dependent"],["Protocol-level deterministic tests covering wiring and one core rule","tests/test_main.cpp","automated-test"],["Fundamental types: Position and Direction (sole definition site)","include/Types.h","interface"],["RNG interface and default deterministic implementation declaration","include/IRandom.h","interface"],["Default RNG implementation using std::mt19937 (includes "IRandom.h" exactly)","src/Random.cpp","domain-entity"],["Board dimensions and bounds checking (grid walls)","include/Board.h","interface"],["Board implementation: store width/height and in-bounds queries","src/Board.cpp","domain-entity"],["Snake body/deque, direction, movement, growth-safe advance, occupancy","include/Snake.h","interface"],["Snake implementation: initialize length-3 body, direction change with reversal prevention","src/Snake.cpp","domain-entity"],["Game orchestration: ticks, direction queue, collisions, food placement, score, reset","include/Game.h","interface"],["Game implementation: apply movement rules, wouldSelfCollide helper, deterministic RNG placement","src/Game.cpp","orchestration"]],"File list":["CMakeLists.txt","src/Main.cpp","tests/test_main.cpp","include/Types.h","include/IRandom.h","src/Random.cpp","include/Board.h","src/Board.cpp","include/Snake.h","src/Snake.cpp","include/Game.h","src/Game.cpp"],"Canonical File References":["CMakeLists.txt","src/Main.cpp","tests/test_main.cpp","include/Types.h","include/IRandom.h","src/Random.cpp","include/Board.h","src/Board.cpp","include/Snake.h","src/Snake.cpp","include/Game.h","src/Game.cpp"],"Data structures and interfaces":"classDiagram
    class Position {
        int x
        int y
    }
    class Direction {
        <<enum>> Up
        <<enum>> Down
        <<enum>> Left
        <<enum>> Right
    }
    class IRandom {
        <<interface>>
        +~IRandom()
        +next(maxExclusive: std::size_t) std::size_t
    }
    class DefaultRandom {
        -engine: std::mt19937
        +DefaultRandom(seed: std::uint32_t)
        +next(maxExclusive: std::size_t) std::size_t
    }
    class Board {
        -width_: std::size_t
        -height_: std::size_t
        +Board(width: std::size_t, height: std::size_t)
        +getWidth() std::size_t
        +getHeight() std::size_t
        +inBounds(p: Position) bool
    }
    class Snake {
        -body_: std::deque<Position>
        -dir_: Direction
        +Snake(start: Position, dir: Direction, initialLength: int)
        +head() Position
        +tail() Position
        +body() const std::deque<Position>&
        +direction() Direction
        +trySetDirection(d: Direction) bool
        +advanceTo(next: Position, grow: bool) void
        +occupies(p: Position) bool
    }
    class Game {
        -board_: Board
        -rng_: IRandom&
        -snake_: Snake
        -food_: std::optional<Position>
        -score_: std::size_t
        -gameOver_: bool
        -pendingDir_: std::optional<Direction>
        +Game(width: std::size_t, height: std::size_t, rng: IRandom&)
        +reset() void
        +setDirection(d: Direction) void
        +tick() void
        +isGameOver() bool
        +getScore() std::size_t
        +getSnake() const Snake&
        +getFood() std::optional<Position>
        -placeFood() void
        -wouldSelfCollide(next: Position, grow: bool) const bool
    }
    DefaultRandom ..|> IRandom
    Game --> Board
    Game --> Snake
    Game --> IRandom
    Snake --> Position
    Snake --> Direction
    Board --> Position","Program call flow":"sequenceDiagram
    participant R as runtime (src/Main.cpp)
    participant G as Game
    participant S as Snake
    participant B as Board
    participant RNG as IRandom/DefaultRandom
    R->>RNG: construct(seed)
    R->>G: construct(width,height,RNG)
    G->>B: init bounds
    G->>S: init centered length=3 dir=Right
    G->>G: placeFood()
    loop ticks
        R->>G: setDirection(optional)
        R->>G: tick()
        G->>S: apply pending direction
        G->>S: compute next head
        G->>B: inBounds(next)
        G->>S: wouldSelfCollide(next, grow?)
        alt eating food
            G->>S: advanceTo(next,grow=true)
            G->>G: score++ and placeFood()
        else normal move
            G->>S: advanceTo(next,grow=false)
        end
    end
    R-->>R: print summary and exit","Domain Mapping":[["Fundamental types: Position and Direction (sole definition site)","include/Types.h"],["RNG interface and default deterministic RNG they link via the core library"]},"Python Dependency Compatibility Audit":{"not_applicable":true,"uses_outdated_pins":false,"version_range_recommendations":[],"headless_test_notes":""},"Full API spec":"include/Types.h:
- struct Position { int x; int y; };
- enum class Direction { Up, Down, Left, Right };
Semantics: Position uses integer grid coordinates. Direction enumerates movement axes. This header is the sole definition site for both Position and Direction; any header using them must include this header directly.

include/IRandom.h:
- class IRandom { public: virtual ~IRandom() = default; virtual std::size_t next(std::size_t maxExclusive) = 0; };
- class DefaultRandom final : public IRandom { public: explicit DefaultRandom(std::uint32_t seed); std::size_t next(std::size_t maxExclusive) override; private: std::mt19937 engine_; };
Semantics: next(maxExclusive) returns an integer in [0, maxExclusive) uniformly. Behavior is deterministic given the seed. Header includes <cstddef>, <cstdint>, and <random> and uses std::size_t, std::uint32_t, std::mt19937.

include/Board.h:
- class Board { public: Board(std::size_t width, std::size_t height); std::size_t getWidth() const noexcept; std::size_t getHeight() const noexcept; bool inBounds(Position p) const noexcept; private: std::size_t width_; std::size_t height_; };
Semantics: Stores immutable grid dimensions. inBounds returns true iff 0 <= p.x < width and 0 <= p.y < height.

include/Snake.h:
- class Snake { public: Snake(Position start, Direction dir, int initialLength); Position head() const; Position tail() const; const std::deque<Position>& body() const noexcept; Direction direction() const noexcept; bool trySetDirection(Direction d); void advanceTo(Position next, bool grow); bool occupies(Position p) const noexcept; private: std::deque<Position> body_; Direction dir_; };
Semantics: Constructor initializes a length-3 body when called by Game as per protocol, extending opposite to initial direction. trySetDirection prevents 180-degree reversal relative to current direction; returns true if accepted, false if ignored. advanceTo moves head to 'next'; if grow is false, it pops the tail; if grow is true, it keeps the tail (growing by one). occupies checks if any segment equals p.

include/Game.h:
- class Game { public: Game(std::size_t width, std::size_t height, IRandom& rng); void reset(); void setDirection(Direction d); void tick(); bool isGameOver() const noexcept; std::size_t getScore() const noexcept; const Snake& getSnake() const noexcept; std::optional<Position> getFood() const; private: void placeFood(); bool wouldSelfCollide(Position next, bool grow) const; private: Board board_; IRandom& rng_; Snake snake_; std::optional<Position> food_; std::size_t score_; bool gameOver_; std::optional<Direction> pendingDir_; };
Semantics:
- Construction: validates dimensions (both width and height must be > 0; otherwise throws std::invalid_argument). Initializes the snake exactly as: snake_(Position{static_cast<int>(width / 2), static_cast<int>(height / 2)}, Direction::Right, 3). Resets score_=0, gameOver_=false, pendingDir_=std::nullopt, and places initial food on an unoccupied cell using RNG.
- setDirection: queues a pending direction; actual change is applied at the start of the next tick via Snake::trySetDirection, preserving reversal-prevention.
- tick: if gameOver_ is true, it is a no-op. Otherwise, applies pending direction, computes next head based on current direction, checks board_.inBounds(next) and self-collision via wouldSelfCollide(next, grow). Moving into the current tail position is allowed only when grow == false (i.e., not eating this tick). If next equals current food position, sets grow=true, advances snake with grow=true, increments score_, and calls placeFood(). Otherwise advances with grow=false. If out-of-bounds or self-collide, sets gameOver_=true and does not move further for this tick.
- getFood returns std::nullopt if no food is currently placed (e.g., if board is fully occupied). placeFood selects uniformly among unoccupied cells using rng_.next().

src/Random.cpp:
- Implements DefaultRandom::DefaultRandom(seed) to seed engine_ and DefaultRandom::next(maxExclusive) using uniform_int_distribution in [0, maxExclusive-1]. Includes "IRandom.h" exactly.

src/Board.cpp:
- Implements Board methods; inBounds uses Position from include/Types.h (via include in include/Board.h).

src/Snake.cpp:
- Implements Snake, including reversal prevention in trySetDirection and growth-safe advanceTo.

src/Game.cpp:
- Implements Game: constructor performs validation, initializes snake_ exactly as specified, places food deterministically using rng_ over unoccupied cells, and ensures movement rules including the 'move into tail allowed only if not growing' rule via wouldSelfCollide.

src/Main.cpp:
- Demonstration-only thin runtime: constructs DefaultRandom with fixed seed, constructs Game, performs several ticks, prints a brief summary; no GUI/OS interactions. Not used by tests.

Include boundaries:
- Any header using Position or Direction must include include/Types.h directly.
- include/IRandom.h is the declaration site for both IRandom and DefaultRandom; src/Random.cpp includes only this header from the project.

Testing boundaries:
- tests/test_main.cpp includes only include/Game.h, include/IRandom.h, and include/Types.h, and links via the core library (not by including sources).","Shared Knowledge":"Protocol mandates preserving exact file names and roles.
